results.name: Matrix.trace_single_mul
results.source_text:
theorem trace_single_mul [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] [Fintype m]
    (i : n) (j : m) (a : R) (x : Matrix m n R) :
    (single i j a * x).trace = a • x j i := by
  simp [trace, mul_apply, single, ite_and]

results.name: Algebra.traceMatrix_of_matrix_mulVec
results.source_text:
theorem traceMatrix_of_matrix_mulVec [Fintype κ] (b : κ → B) (P : Matrix κ κ A) :
    traceMatrix A (P.map (algebraMap A B) *ᵥ b) = P * traceMatrix A b * Pᵀ := by
  refine AddEquiv.injective (transposeAddEquiv κ κ A) ?_
  rw [transposeAddEquiv_apply, transposeAddEquiv_apply, ← vecMul_transpose, ← transpose_map,
    traceMatrix_of_matrix_vecMul, transpose_transpose]

results.name: Matrix.trace
results.source_text:
/-- The trace of a square matrix. For more bundled versions, see:
* `Matrix.traceAddMonoidHom`
* `Matrix.traceLinearMap`
-/
def trace (A : Matrix n n R) : R :=
  ∑ i, diag A i
results.docstring:
The trace of a square matrix. For more bundled versions, see:
* `Matrix.traceAddMonoidHom`
* `Matrix.traceLinearMap`

results.name: Algebra.traceMatrix_of_matrix_vecMul
results.source_text:
theorem traceMatrix_of_matrix_vecMul [Fintype κ] (b : κ → B) (P : Matrix κ κ A) :
    traceMatrix A (b ᵥ* P.map (algebraMap A B)) = Pᵀ * traceMatrix A b * P := by
  ext (α β)
  rw [traceMatrix_apply, vecMul, dotProduct, vecMul, dotProduct, Matrix.mul_apply,
    BilinForm.sum_left,
    Fintype.sum_congr _ _ fun i : κ =>
      BilinForm.sum_right _ _ (b i * P.map (algebraMap A B) i α) fun y : κ =>
        b y * P.map (algebraMap A B) y β,
    sum_comm]
  congr; ext x
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, sum_mul]
  congr; ext y
  rw [map_apply, traceForm_apply, mul_comm (b y), ← smul_def]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply, map_apply, transpose_apply, map_smulₛₗ,
    Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
  rw [mul_comm (b x), ← smul_def]
  ring_nf
  rw [mul_assoc]
  simp [mul_comm]

results.name: Algebra.traceMatrix_apply
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem traceMatrix_apply (b : κ → B) (i j) : traceMatrix A b i j = traceForm A B (b i) (b j) :=
  rfl

results.name: PauliMatrix.trace_pauliMatrix_mul_selfAdjoint_re
results.source_text:
/-- The trace of a pauli-matrix multiplied by a self-adjoint `2×2` matrix is real. -/
lemma trace_pauliMatrix_mul_selfAdjoint_re (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)
    (A : selfAdjoint (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) :
    (Matrix.trace (pauliMatrix μ * A.1)).re = Matrix.trace (pauliMatrix μ * A.1) := by
  rw [← Complex.conj_eq_iff_re, starRingEnd_apply, ← trace_conjTranspose, conjTranspose_mul,
    pauliMatrix_selfAdjoint μ, ← star_eq_conjTranspose, A.2, trace_mul_comm]
results.docstring: The trace of a pauli-matrix multiplied by a self-adjoint `2×2` matrix is real.

results.name: Fintype.prod_sum
results.source_text:
/-- A product of sums can be written as a sum of products. -/
lemma prod_sum {κ : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (κ i)] (f : ∀ i, κ i → R) :
    ∏ i, ∑ j, f i j = ∑ x : ∀ i, κ i, ∏ i, f i (x i) := Finset.prod_univ_sum _ _
results.docstring: A product of sums can be written as a sum of products.

results.name: Fintype.prod_sumElim
results.source_text:
@[to_additive]
theorem Fintype.prod_sumElim (f : α₁ → M) (g : α₂ → M) :
    ∏ x, Sum.elim f g x = (∏ a₁, f a₁) * ∏ a₂, g a₂ :=
  prod_disjSum _ _ _

results.name: Fintype.sum_equiv
results.source_text:
@[to_additive /-- `Fintype.sum_equiv` is a specialization of `Finset.sum_bij` that
automatically fills in most arguments.

See `Equiv.sum_comp` for a version without `h`. -/]
lemma prod_equiv (e : ι ≃ κ) (f : ι → M) (g : κ → M) (h : ∀ x, f x = g (e x)) :
    ∏ x, f x = ∏ x, g x := prod_bijective _ e.bijective _ _ h
results.docstring:
`Fintype.sum_equiv` is a specialization of `Finset.sum_bij` that
automatically fills in most arguments.

See `Equiv.sum_comp` for a version without `h`.

results.name: Equiv.psigmaCongrRight
results.source_text:
/-- A family of equivalences `Π a, β₁ a ≃ β₂ a` generates an equivalence between `Σ' a, β₁ a` and
`Σ' a, β₂ a`. -/
@[simps (attr := grind =) apply]
def psigmaCongrRight {β₁ β₂ : α → Sort*} (F : ∀ a, β₁ a ≃ β₂ a) : (Σ' a, β₁ a) ≃ Σ' a, β₂ a where
  toFun a := ⟨a.1, F a.1 a.2⟩
  invFun a := ⟨a.1, (F a.1).symm a.2⟩
  left_inv := by grind
  right_inv := by grind
results.docstring:
A family of equivalences `Π a, β₁ a ≃ β₂ a` generates an equivalence between `Σ' a, β₁ a` and
`Σ' a, β₂ a`.

results.name: KroneckerDelta.kroneckerDelta_finSumFinEquiv
results.source_text:
/-- The Kronecker delta is invariant under the component-index equivalence `finSumFinEquiv`. -/
lemma kroneckerDelta_finSumFinEquiv (a b : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    kroneckerDelta (finSumFinEquiv a) (finSumFinEquiv b) = kroneckerDelta a b := by
  simp only [kroneckerDelta, Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq]
results.docstring: The Kronecker delta is invariant under the component-index equivalence `finSumFinEquiv`.

results.name: Equiv.sumEquivSigmalCond
results.source_text:
/-- An alternative form of `Equiv.sumEquivSigmaBool` where `Bool.casesOn` is replaced by `cond`. -/
def sumEquivSigmalCond : Fin m ⊕ Fin n ≃ Σ b, cond b (Fin m) (Fin n) :=
  calc Fin m ⊕ Fin n
    _ ≃ Fin n ⊕ Fin m := sumComm ..
    _ ≃ Σ b, bif b then (Fin m) else (Fin n) := sumEquivSigmaBool ..
    _ ≃ Σ b, cond b (Fin m) (Fin n) := sigmaCongrRight (fun | true | false => Equiv.refl _)
results.docstring: An alternative form of `Equiv.sumEquivSigmaBool` where `Bool.casesOn` is replaced by `cond`.
